kind.description: name of the k8s Custom Resource

widgetData.description: the data that will be passed to the widget on the frontend

rest.description: rest api call actions triggered by the widget

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before triggering the action

errorMessage.description: a message that will be displayed inside a toast in case of error

fanOutPath.description: name of an ARRAY field in the submitted values: the action fans out into ONE ordered write per element (for each write, that field is replaced by the single element before payload/payloadToOverride interpolation). The whole set is gated behind ONE aggregated blast-radius confirm and dispatched sequentially with stop-on-first-error and per-item results (W0-4 applySet semantics); onEventNavigateTo is not supported on a fan-out action

ops.description: ordered list of DISTINCT writes applied as ONE gated set (e.g. one Form submit creating a Role AND its RoleBinding): each op resolves its OWN resourceRefId (verb + path + payload base) and builds its OWN payload/payloadToOverride against the SAME submitted values. The whole set is gated behind ONE aggregated blast-radius confirm and dispatched sequentially with stop-on-first-error and per-item results (W0-4 applySet semantics). Mutually exclusive with fanOutPath; onEventNavigateTo is not supported on a multi-op action. The action's own top-level payload/payloadToOverride are IGNORED when ops is present and its top-level resourceRefId is ignored for dispatch (it must still name a valid resource ref — point it at the first op's)

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the resource ref this op targets: its verb (must be mutating), path and payload base

payload.description: static payload sent with this op's request

payloadToOverride.description: list of this op's payload fields to override dynamically (values interpolate against the same submitted values as every other op)

name.description: name of the field to override

value.description: value to use for overriding the field

successMessage.description: a message that will be displayed inside a toast in case of success

onSuccessNavigateTo.description: url to navigate to after successful execution

onEventNavigateTo.description: conditional navigation triggered by a specific event

eventReason.description: identifier of the awaited event reason

url.description: url to navigate to when the event is received

timeout.description: the timeout in seconds to wait for the event

reloadRoutes.description: Re-fetch the route table before navigating. Set it when the action creates its own destination — publishing a new page, for example — so the route exists by the time the navigation happens.

loadingMessage.description: message to display while waiting for the event

headers.description: array of headers as strings, format 'key: value'

items.description: key and value as a single, example: 'x-custom-header: value'

payload.description: static payload sent with the request

payloadToOverride.description: list of payload fields to override dynamically

name.description: name of the field to override

value.description: value to use for overriding the field

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

path.description: the identifier of the route to navigate to

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before navigating

openDrawer.description: actions to open side drawer components

id.description: unique identifier for the drawer action

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before opening

title.description: title shown in the drawer header

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

openModal.description: actions to open modal dialog components

id.description: unique identifier for the modal action

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before opening

title.description: title shown in the modal header

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

customWidth.description: the custom width of the value, which should be used by setting the 'custom' value inside the 'size' property

size.description: sets the Modal size, 'default' is 520px, 'large' is 80% of the screen width, 'fullscreen' is 100% of the screen width, 'custom' should be used with the 'customWidth' property

allowedResources.description: the resource plurals this container may hold as children. Typed loosely on purpose — the per-widget enums drifted and enforced nothing; containment is checked by the chart lint (design rule X5) against the real widget registry.

buttonConfig.description: custom labels and icons for form buttons

navigateTo.description: when set, the secondary button is a Cancel that navigates to this route (SPA) instead of resetting the form

draft.description: draft button configuration — only rendered when widgetData.draftActionId is also set; clicking it persists the current (un-validated) field values via that action

review.description: Configure-step button label when reviewBeforeSubmit is set (the button that opens the in-place Review; default 'Review →')

label.description: text label for the Review button

reviewBack.description: Review-step back button label when reviewBeforeSubmit is set (returns to editing; default '← Back to edit')

label.description: text label for the back-to-edit button

draftActionId.description: optional id of an action fired by a 'Save draft' button that captures the CURRENT field values WITHOUT running form validation (so an incomplete form can be persisted). Pair with buttonConfig.draft to show the button.

initialValues.description: optional object with initial values for form fields. Keys should match form field names (supports nested objects). These values override schema defaults.

items.description: resourceRefIds of form-control widgets (Input, Select, Switch, …) to compose inside the Form. Composable mode — an alternative to the schema/stringSchema generator.

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the form-control widget to render

propertiesToHide.description: top-level schema property names to omit from the schema-driven form

reviewBeforeSubmit.description: when true (inline render only), the primary button validates and reveals an in-place read-only Review of the entered values before the real submit — the form stays mounted so 'Back to edit' preserves every value. Pair with buttonConfig.review / buttonConfig.reviewBack for custom labels.

schema.description: JSON schema (e.g. a blueprint CRD's openAPIV3Schema spec) rendered as form fields — the schema-driven alternative to `items`. Usually populated server-side via a widgetDataTemplate jq expression that extracts the spec schema. Note: a schema sourced from a CRD's openAPIV3Schema has its `properties` map serialized alphabetically (order lost); use `stringSchema` to preserve the source values.schema.json authoring order.

stringSchema.description: Same JSON schema as `schema`, but as a raw JSON STRING. Preferred over `schema` when present: the client JSON.parses it, preserving key insertion order, so fields render in the source values.schema.json order rather than the alphabetized order a CRD-sourced object schema yields. Typically populated server-side from the blueprint's per-version jsonschema ConfigMap (which keeps authoring order). Falls back to `schema` when absent or not valid JSON.

submitActionId.description: the id of the action to be called when the form is submitted

submitActionSelector.description: optional field-conditional submit routing: when present, the submit action is chosen at submit time from the value of the named field. Routes one form to different create targets (e.g. a 'target cluster' select where 'local' posts the blueprint instance and a remote spoke posts a RemoteInstall). Falls back to `default` (or `submitActionId`) when the field value has no mapping.

field.description: form field whose current value selects the submit action

default.description: action id used when the field value is not present in `map`

submitDisabledWhenPristine.description: when true, the primary (submit) button stays disabled until at least one field differs from its initial value (initialValues overlaid on schema defaults). Use for update forms where submitting an unchanged value is a no-op — e.g. a version picker pre-set to the currently-installed version.

name.description: Name of the RESTAction resource to call.

apiRef.description: Binds this widget to a RESTAction whose response feeds the widgetDataTemplate and resourcesRefsTemplate expressions. Omit it for a widget whose data is entirely static.

forPath.description: Dot-path inside widgetData whose value this expression replaces, for example `items[0].title`.

expression.description: A jq expression evaluated server-side against the apiRef response. Its result replaces the value at forPath.

widgetDataTemplate.description: Per-field overrides evaluated against the apiRef response, so one authored widget can render live cluster data. Each entry replaces one value inside widgetData.

allowed.description: Set server-side: whether the caller may perform this verb. False entries are stripped before the widget renders and are never authored by hand.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before the returned page.

perPage.description: Maximum items in the returned page.

continue.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response, used to fetch the next page.

slice.description: Server-side paging for this reference: the widget receives one page rather than the whole list.

items.description: One referenced resource. The widget addresses it by its `id`, never by name.

resourcesRefs.description: The resources this widget references by id. Each entry is resolved server-side and its endpoint handed to the widget; entries the caller may not read are removed before the widget renders, so a denied reference reads as absence rather than as an error.

iterator.description: A jq expression selecting the array in the apiRef response to iterate over.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

template.description: The resourcesRefs entry emitted for each iterated element; its fields may interpolate that element.

resourcesRefsTemplate.description: Generates resourcesRefs entries from the apiRef response — one per element the iterator yields — so a widget can reference a list whose length it does not know when authored.

spec.description: The widget's contract: its own data, an optional binding to a RESTAction, the resources it references, and any templated overrides.
